scenarios: Trusted dependencies are fixed at service construction and cannot be replaced per request.
Identity verification is bound to the configured company and audience.
Identity issuer failure, malformed claims, expiry or invalid epoch fails closed.
Trusted scheduler resolves task; caller cannot choose company, agent or role.
Task company, assigned agent, expiry and nonempty operation/resource scopes are checked.
Trusted clock failure or invalid value fails closed.
Owner approval signature verification is performed by the bound verifier.
Owner ID must be in the trusted owner registry.
Approval is bound to company, stream, agent, session, task, operation, resource, policy, audience and nonce.
Approval must be single-use and within its validity interval.
Amount must use integer minor units and include a currency.
Durable repository receipt must match approval ID, company, scope digest and expiry.
Repository errors or malformed receipts fail closed.
Facade returns no database connection or direct SQL capability.
Agent-facing APIs cannot invoke owner-only approval endpoint without service-layer authentication.
Prototype does not claim production cryptographic or distributed guarantees.
